Everything your body stops getting when the medication does its job, in the exact amounts that bring your system back into balance without pushing past it.

Four months. $1,600 in injections. And the difference between my body and my sister's was a $30 supplement her doctor treats as day-one standard care.

The clinical trial data on stalls. It all checked out. I'd scrolled past this stuff for months assuming it was scammy. Some of it is. The biology isn't.

60 day money back guarantee. After paying $400 a month for nothing, $30 was not the risk in my life.

The scale moved. Three pounds. In one week. After four months of nothing.

Nothing about my medication changed. Same drug, same dose, same Sunday shot.

The medication didn't suddenly start working. It had been working the whole time. My body finally had what it needed to stop fighting it.

The fatigue lifted. I was cooking dinner again. I had energy past 5pm. That's when I actually believed it.

For four months I thought I was a non responder. The person the miracle skips.

My body was missing everything it needed to let the medication work. And not one person in a white coat thought to mention it.
